reviews.title: Zzzz another lame to-do app
reviews.text: I’m desperate for a decent to-do app, but everyone I’ve tried has felt outdated and more effort than writing on a Post-it.  You would think that with all the advances in AI a to-do app could part-create a reminder.  Still at least it’s better than Apples latest lazy, unfinished effort.

I have used Todoist for years and now I’m back to TickTick. It has so many more features and is yet simpler to use

reviews.title: Ok - aber kein Apple-Kalender!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Grundsätzlich ist die App für Aufgabenplanung sehr gut geeignet. Aber Was mich aber massiv stört ist:  Kalender von Outlook und Google lassen sich einbinden, Apple/iCloud jedoch nicht. Das ist für mich ein massiver Mangel, zahlt man immerhin für die Kalendereinbindung. Und eine App für iOS anzubieten, Apples Kalender jedoch auszuschließen ist ein NO-GO!!!!! Wenn das geändert wurde bin ich gerne Kunde.

reviews.title: It doesn’t work!!
reviews.text:
I’m disappointed with Todoist’s notifications. Even for urgent tasks and reminders, the notification appears briefly and disappears like a regular notification, making it very easy to miss.

I expected stronger, more persistent alerts—especially for important tasks. For a paid productivity app, the reminder system should be much more noticeable and reliable.

reviews.title: Completely loses items
reviews.text: I had a long list of items in a ‘project’ I had laboriously copied ovet from Apple Reminders app.  Today opened Todoist and 90% of them were gone without a trace.  Not marked completed, not marked deleted, not even appearing at all in the ‘activity’ section as having been entered.  I can only guess required syncing to Todoist servers rather than much superior local storage is completely broken and a SEVERE risk for anyone using this app.  Avoid at all costs.

reviews.title: App is trash
reviews.text: No reason to download this app is because it’s supposed to integrate with ChatGPT. Unfortunately, every time you tell ChatGPT to put this as a reminder or put this on my calendar, it comes back and says sorry. There’s a hiccup on our end. I can’t integrate that really is happening every single time both apps are up-to-date. It just doesn’t work.

reviews.title: Almost awesome
reviews.text:
The review is based on the value for multiple users of a paid subscription.  

The fact that this isn’t eligible for family sharing is a dealbreaker for the paid subscription- we fortunately realized before the free period ran out.  We wanted to pay for the app, but the cost is too high when the free version is good enough.  If we could do family share on a pro subscription, it would be perfect.

reviews.title: Nice app with extortion pricing
reviews.text:
$60/year for a todo list? Are you guys out of your minds? 

This app should be $5-$10 one time. A subscription at all is insane. 

Greed at its finest.

reviews.title: User
reviews.text: I was enjoying it but with software updates it tells me to download the latest version but will not allow it (I guess the new version can’t be run on older platforms). So, it still asks me to download the new version each time I open it, and it now no longer syncs between devices. And, as far as I can tell, there is NO WAY to contact customer support or get any help with it. A useful tool which has become a time suck..

reviews.title: La mise à jour fait tout perdre
reviews.text:
J'étais contente de cette appli dont je fais un usage très simple : juste des listes, pas de partage, pas d'objectifs, juste lister des choses pour me libérer l'esprit.
L'appli a exigé une mise à jour, sans m'avertir de synchroniser mes données avant, sans me dire qu'elle effacerait tout.
Des mois de données effacées ! 
Tout ça pour une forme plus "reseaux sociaux" dont je n'ai nullement besoin.
Pas sûre de continuer à m'en servir, dans ces conditions

reviews.title: No longer supporting older iOS and shutting down!
reviews.text: I’ve been paid a user of this app for years. It’s helped me manage my cognitive needs as a part of my disability. Some of the updates to this app have made it less accessible and when I’ve reached out, I’ve never gotten a response. Now, the developers/management have decided to no longer support devices below iOS 17 and they are shutting my version down. My devices STILL work and I cannot afford to buy new things. These business decisions are made because the bottom line matters more than access and people with special needs do not matter. That is a horrible thing to experience. I can’t express my disappointment to loose access (and the energy I’ll need to use to learn something new) when this app stops working across my devices if I don’t spend money to get new stuff. AND the browser isn’t supported on a mobile device when they shut down the app! Their response to my “no longer supported device is that I can use it on my other devices. For the well-healed crowd apparently! And they just charged me for another year and none of my devices work!

reviews.text:
At this price and stage of development, I would really expect Apple calendar sync. Without it this app is useless to me.

Also no import from other apps and the user interface is a lot more confusing than it used to be. 

Not a fan currently.

reviews.title: 100% price increase?
reviews.text:
Not all people care about yet-another ai noise you are trying to add to your app.

Please reconsider and keep current subscription as default (you can even reasonably raise it a bit) and only ask extra for ai stuff from people who actually want it.

P.S. The "disappointing" is how you've handled the price change and the feedback from the community. I've cancelled the subscription after years of paying. It is super easy nowadays to migrate to any other todo app 🤷‍♂️

reviews.title: Mon avis sur l’application
reviews.text: Que l’application est génial, mais le seul inconvénient et d’ailleurs qui vous a fait perdre beaucoup d’étoiles, c’est que tous les jours nous avons des notifications dans messagerie et cela est un peu pénible tous les jours. Je dois aller dans ma messagerie pour consulter vos messages qui ne sert strictement à rien. voilà c’était mon petit avis, je sais pas si vous allez en prendre conte  mais au moins peut-être vous aller essayé de vous améliorer.

reviews.title: It’s a Browser App
reviews.text: As much as I want to like Todoist, it acts and feels like I’m surfing on a Website and I hate it. Especially in dark mode when you switch between the tabs it suddenly changes the background color all the time. Even the gifs when no task is set have a different background color than the actual background, it’s just ugly. Or the pull to reload you can do on every single page is exactly like in a browser. I hate it. Please make a proper iOS and macOS app.
